-- ============================================================
-- test-support.fh  –  Gemeinsame Typen für alle Test-Module
-- ============================================================

module Test.Support

error NotFound
error InvalidInput
error Overflow

type Point is record
    x: Integer
    y: Integer
end record

type Box is record
    origin: Point
    width:  Integer
    height: Integer
end record

type Labeled is record
    name:  String
    amount: Integer
end record

function make_point(x: Integer, y: Integer) returns Point
requires x >= 0, y >= 0
ensures result.x = x, result.y = y
is
    return Point { x: x, y: y }
end make_point

function make_box(ox: Integer, oy: Integer, w: Integer, h: Integer) returns Box
requires ox >= 0, oy >= 0, w > 0, h > 0
ensures result.width = w, result.height = h
is
    let origin: Point = make_point(ox, oy)
    return Box { origin: origin, width: w, height: h }
end make_box

function make_labeled(name: String, amount: Integer) returns Labeled
requires String.instr(name, "") = 0, amount >= 0
ensures result.name = name, result.amount = amount
is
    return Labeled { name: name, amount: amount }
end make_labeled

end Test.Support
